scope: Local train-only review of active-context event order, elapsed age and quantity history; no architecture implementation or model fitting
population: Reuse exactly the paired 8192 train target IDs and two disjoint-series folds from the prior query diagnosis; lazily filter train before collecting parquet rows

history_contract.loader: Unmodified RMTPPWeekLookbackDataset with original lookback and max_seq_len, original clip_dt_min1 and original train-only target selection
history_contract.observations: Exclude the appended target and every padding position before feature calculation or perturbation
history_contract.quantity_input: log1p observed quantities; changes are available through the full observed sequence
history_contract.age: age_i = sum(dts[i+1:H]); first retained gap may cross the context boundary and is excluded from all internal ages and internal mean gap
history_contract.age_distortion: J = RMS(age_i / internal_span - (H-1-i)/(H-1)); eligible H>=3 and positive internal span; equal spacing gives zero
history_contract.scale_limit: J is invariant to common multiplication of all internal gaps; it measures relative timing layout, not all temporal information
history_contract.count_change_rms: RMS adjacent differences of observed log1p quantity
history_contract.short_history: Record short histories; J unavailable for H<3, internal mean gap unavailable for H=1; never treat unavailable J as regular timing

association.primary_metric: Raw quantity MAE among targets <= original full-train p95; target quantity used only for error/body membership
association.cutpoint_scope: All eligible input histories in the opposite series fold, independent of target values and model errors
association.ties: Unique sorted control boundaries; low J <= lower cut, high J >= upper cut; reject nonseparated J cuts
association.standardization: Within each retained fold/control cell each arm receives total mass min(n_high,n_low); row weight is cell mass divided by its arm count; both models use identical rows and weights
association.bootstrap: Resample series independently within each fold, keep cutpoints/cells/row weights fixed, renormalize each arm; conditional on frozen standardization, not rematching uncertainty

relevance_gate.interpretation: An error-association relevance screen, not evidence that a candidate improves MAE by 5% or a causal time-encoding effect

sensitivity.selection: Uniform without replacement from the fixed cached sample with H>=4, chosen before predictions; same rows for both checkpoints
outputs: local state relative change and cosine
quantity logit and log1p prediction change
sensitivity.interpretation: Frozen functional sensitivity only; transformed histories have no known counterfactual target and may be out of distribution

single_conditional_hypothesis: Within the existing active context, an explicit relative elapsed-age relation in local attention may improve quantity prediction for irregular timing histories; define as a future candidate only if the predeclared association gate passes
nonduplication: No time-head distribution or loss replacement
No top-k, key/value, temperature or memory-fusion change
stop_condition: Record code path, timing exposure, conditional error association and bounded sensitivity; select the one time-relation hypothesis only with sufficient support, otherwise hold without a feature search
limitations: Backbone checkpoints already saw all these train rows and used validation for selection
Conditional association does not remove unmeasured confounding
Sensitivity is not feature importance or performance causation
Failure from low timing variation or poor overlap is insufficient evidence, not proof temporal representation cannot help
The existing absolute-position/log-gap path can in principle learn timing relationships; absence of an explicit bias does not prove it fails
